proof.criterion: A standby still takes a free hold promptly by every remaining wake: the release NOTIFY, a new LISTEN connection, and its NATS connection coming back
proof.surface: real envoy-dispatch binaries; the standby's database or its NATS behind a cuttable TCP proxy

proof.observed: SIGTERM to the holder: the standby took the hold 19 ms after the signal.
